scope: AU thoroughbreds, strict identity/distance join with historical TAB-derived static fields
decision_time: scheduled-start price; retrospective static metadata reconstructed from results, not certified morning snapshots
exposure: ALL evaluation dates overlap prior V5 development data; this is feature-development diagnostic evidence, NOT a fresh holdout. September-October 2026 is not opened or scored again.
history: 2020 through previous local date, outcome-only history from retained Betfair AU races; connections/going available only in joined 2025 history
same_day_outcomes: withheld until next local date; actual result publication timestamps unavailable
candidates: one fixed histogram gradient boosting classifier, blended with market at 10% or 25%
selection: lowest validation race log loss, market eligible; no retuning on diagnostic
unavailable_inputs: weights/claims, gear and first-after-gelding, age/sex, sectionals and pace are not inferred; feature engine accepts timestamped overlays and records unknowns
overlay_timing: source_url and published_at required; published_at must be <= scheduled_start_utc per record; effective date+race+horse identity exact
trading: no deployment/real bets; scheduled quote return proxy only; no liquidity, scratch timeline or reduction-factor reconstruction
